message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-15 13:10 IST to 2026-11-16 13:10 IST (2026-11-15 07:40 UTC to 2026-11-16 07:40 UTC)  
**Scope:** DLL_software_component.txt only. Obvious aliases and duplicate component/version entries were normalized within this file. Products.txt and List_of_SIA_Completed.txt were not read or combined.

No new vulnerability published or materially updated during the exact 24-hour window could be verified as relevant to a component and version in the assigned DLL inventory.

### Findings

No confirmed in-scope findings.

Fresh records reviewed for November 15-16 primarily affected unrelated products. Similar-name results such as Zr.Admin.NET and separate Oracle products were rejected because they do not match the inventoried components. Older advisories for Telerik, AutoMapper, Microsoft packages, and other listed technologies were excluded because they predated the cutoff.

### MongoDB ecosystem coverage

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, major maintained libraries and services, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, CISA sources, and credible security research.

No MongoDB finding fell inside the scan window. MongoDB's [authoritative alert feed](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) showed its newest security notices before this run's cutoff.

**Closing:** No immediate vulnerability review is recommended from this 24-hour DLL-component scan. Continue routine monitoring.
